lookBones.head: Head
lookBones.note: In the bind pose these bones' local axes match the model axes (+X = character's left, +Y = up, +Z = forward): yaw = rotation about local Y, pitch about local X.

seat.note: In every Sit_* clip the pelvis joint is ON the seat surface (0.45 m for scale 1) with the feet flat on the ground; align the pelvis bone world position with the seat_XX marker. With the character scale the seated pelvis sits at sitPelvisHeight above the feet (0.414-0.477 m), so on a 0.45 m seat the feet float/sink by up to ~4 cm; Sit_Stand ends standing ~0.24 m in front of the seat point, Stand_Sit starts there.

firstPerson.note: Scale the Head bone to 0 on your own avatar; seatedEyeOffset = eye midpoint relative to the pelvis bone in Sit_Idle (three.js axes, metres, character scale included).

orientation: Origin on the ground between the feet, facing +Z, 1 unit = 1 m.

clipsNotes.Sit_Point: right arm extended straight forward, index finger; hold the last frame, rotate the torso towards the target
clipsNotes.Sit_RaiseHand: right hand raised; hold the last frame
clipsNotes.Sit_Death: ends lying on the ground in front of the seat (clampWhenFinished)
clipsNotes.Wolf_Howl: drive the MouthOpen morph target during the howl (0.6 s .. 3.0 s)
clipsNotes.Walk: in place, retargeted from Quaternius UAL Walk_Loop (CC0)
